subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Twelve Months and Zodiac Signs
description: A fast breakdown of Twelve Months and Zodiac Signs for builders.

hook.text: Twelve months. Twelve zodiac signs. Twelve hours on a clock face. Twelve structures the way we measure time.

buildup.text: The Babylonians divided the sky into twelve zones because the moon cycles roughly twelve times per year.

discovery.text: The zodiac assigns each month a constellation and personality. Astrology made twelve a cosmic personality system.

twist.text: Twelve works because it's highly divisible: by 2, 3, 4, and 6. It's practical, not mystical—but we made it sacred.

climax.text: Twelve connects sky, calendar, and identity. A number born from lunar math became a symbol of cosmic order.

punchline.text: Twelve moons. Twelve signs. One sky.

quiz.question: Why did the Babylonians favor the number twelve?
options: The moon cycles roughly twelve times per year
